blocks.text:
With notifications allowed, a device gets a message when each door opens, even with the site closed.

The message comes from "notification" in calendar.json, where {day} stands for the door number. A day can set its own in its day.json, like this one: "Last door: Merry Christmas! 🎄".

That is the whole tour. Merry Christmas, and have fun filling a calendar of your own.
